mechanism_defects.summary: gmail.message_reads@1 marks a later gmail_send_email as an unavailable read fact (gmail_observation_read_changed_scope, environments/automationbench_v1/src/automationbench_v1/contracts/gmail_observations.py:174) and a gmail_find_email whose native result is an error as unavailable (gmail_observation_find_result_unavailable, gmail_observations.py:67). Either makes the read inventory incomplete, and effect_joins treat any incomplete inventory as unknown even when the unavailable fact is after the join window (obligations.py:291 `unknown = not evidence.complete`). Result: every 'policy read before acting' join is unknown in any run that also sends an email, including the correct runs.
mechanism_defects.observed: read+pause: complete=True; read+pause+send: complete=False (send at revision 3 unavailable); field-scoped find (native error)+read+pause: complete=False.
mechanism_defects.suggested_fix: Exclude Gmail write occurrences from the read inventory (they are sends, not reads), treat a returned native error as a decided zero-message observation, and let a join ignore unavailable facts whose applied_revision is after the join limit.

mechanism_defects.summary: An effect join publishes join.<alias> only when exactly one joined fact matches (environments/automationbench_v1/src/automationbench_v1/contracts/obligations.py:307 `if unknown or len(matched) > 1: continue`). For existence/ordering joins ('the policy was read before this pause', 'this post was queued before the summary') two reads of the same message (find + get) or a post queued in two formats make the join unknown.
mechanism_defects.observed: one read: join matched; find + get of the same message: join absent, effect_match unknown.
mechanism_defects.suggested_fix: Join option `cardinality: "exists"` publishing matched when >=1 qualified fact matches (joined.* omitted).

mechanism_defects.summary: mentions mode verbatim requires a string value (environments/automationbench_v1/src/automationbench_v1/contracts/predicates.py:558); a numeric source cell (ctr 0.6, spend 8420.0) is always unknown, and amount mode cannot tell '0.60' or '$8,420' from the verbatim '0.6'/'8420.0'.
